                        VALUES (?, ?, ?)

SELECT p.page_id, p.title, p.url, snippet(wiki_fts, 2, '', '', '...', 15)
                    FROM wiki_fts f
                    JOIN wiki_pages p ON f.page_id = p.page_id
                    WHERE wiki_fts MATCH ?
                    LIMIT 20

SELECT page_id, title, url, content_markdown
            FROM wiki_pages
            WHERE title LIKE ? OR content_markdown LIKE ?
            LIMIT 20
